ordered_diagnoses: Pemphigus herpetiformis variant with IgG and C3 deposition

s1.syndrome_frame: Painful erosive skin lesion around a stoma site with suprabasal epidermal splitting and acantholysis
salient_findings: Painful, erosive lesion around the stoma on the anterior abdominal wall
Suprabasal epidermal splitting with acantholysis on histopathology
Intercellular deposition of IgG and C3 throughout epidermis on direct immunofluorescence
key_facts: Patient has a 10-year history of Crohn disease
Patient underwent total proctocolectomy and ileostomy
Painful, erosive lesion developed 5 weeks after surgery
Lesion is located around the stoma on the anterior abdominal wall
Repeated microbiological cultures were negative
Histopathology showed epidermal erosion with suprabasal epidermal splitting and acantholysis
Direct immunofluorescence showed intercellular deposition of IgG and C3 throughout epidermis
High levels of IgG autoantibodies against desmoglein 1 and desmoglein 3 were detected

shortlist.label: Pemphigus vulgaris
shortlist.why_kept: High levels of IgG autoantibodies against desmoglein 1 and 3, suprabasal epidermal splitting with acantholysis

shortlist.label: Pemphigus foliaceus
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of autoantibodies against desmoglein 1, erosive skin lesion around stoma site

shortlist.label: Paraneoplastic pemphigus
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of Crohn disease, which may be associated with paraneoplastic pemphigus

shortlist.label: Pemphigus herpetiformis
shortlist.why_kept: Suprabasal epidermal splitting with acantholysis, presence of IgG autoantibodies

shortlist.label: Pemphigus herpetiformis variant with IgG and C3 deposition
shortlist.why_kept: Direct immunofluorescence showed intercellular deposition of IgG and C3 throughout epidermis

raw.rationale: The presence of suprabasal epidermal splitting with acantholysis, intercellular deposition of IgG and C3 throughout the epidermis, and high levels of IgG autoantibodies against desmoglein 1 and desmoglein 3 are characteristic of Pemphigus vulgaris.

rejected.label: Pemphigus foliaceus
rejected.why: Pemphigus foliaceus typically involves subcorneal epidermal splitting and autoantibodies against desmoglein 1 only.

rejected.label: Paraneoplastic pemphigus
rejected.why: Paraneoplastic pemphigus is associated with underlying neoplasms and typically involves a more complex autoantibody profile.

rejected.label: Pemphigus herpetiformis
rejected.why: Pemphigus herpetiformis is a variant of pemphigus that presents with a herpetiform pattern and is less likely given the clinical presentation.

rejected.label: Pemphigus herpetiformis variant with IgG and C3 deposition
rejected.why: While this variant could be considered, the clinical and histopathological findings more strongly support Pemphigus vulgaris.
